# Scope: none. Yearly: a book written in the last 50 years may draw a cherem
# from a scholar who has not read it but opposes what it argues for
# (kehillah_review_unread_effect), at most kehillah_review_unread_cap a year.
kehillah_review_yearly_unread_effect = {
	set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_review_unread_this_year value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_kuzari_written current_year <= { value = kehillah_lib_year_work_kuzari add = kehillah_review_haskamah_years } global_var:kehillah_review_unread_this_year < kehillah_review_unread_cap }
		kehillah_review_unread_effect = { KEY = work_kuzari }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_written current_year <= { value = kehillah_lib_year_work_rashi_torah add = kehillah_review_haskamah_years } global_var:kehillah_review_unread_this_year < kehillah_review_unread_cap }
		kehillah_review_unread_effect = { KEY = work_rashi_torah }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_talmud_written current_year <= { value = kehillah_lib_year_work_rashi_talmud add = kehillah_review_haskamah_years } global_var:kehillah_review_unread_this_year < kehillah_review_unread_cap }
		kehillah_review_unread_effect = { KEY = work_rashi_talmud }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_hilkhot_harif_written current_year <= { value = kehillah_lib_year_work_hilkhot_harif add = kehillah_review_haskamah_years } global_var:kehillah_review_unread_this_year < kehillah_review_unread_cap }
		kehillah_review_unread_effect = { KEY = work_hilkhot_harif }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_mishneh_torah_written current_year <= { value = kehillah_lib_year_work_mishneh_torah add = kehillah_review_haskamah_years } global_var:kehillah_review_unread_this_year < kehillah_review_unread_cap }
		kehillah_review_unread_effect = { KEY = work_mishneh_torah }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_moreh_nevukhim_written current_year <= { value = kehillah_lib_year_work_moreh_nevukhim add = kehillah_review_haskamah_years } global_var:kehillah_review_unread_this_year < kehillah_review_unread_cap }
		kehillah_review_unread_effect = { KEY = work_moreh_nevukhim }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_sefer_habahir_written current_year <= { value = kehillah_lib_year_work_sefer_habahir add = kehillah_review_haskamah_years } global_var:kehillah_review_unread_this_year < kehillah_review_unread_cap }
		kehillah_review_unread_effect = { KEY = work_sefer_habahir }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_sefer_hasidim_written current_year <= { value = kehillah_lib_year_work_sefer_hasidim add = kehillah_review_haskamah_years } global_var:kehillah_review_unread_this_year < kehillah_review_unread_cap }
		kehillah_review_unread_effect = { KEY = work_sefer_hasidim }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_tosafot_written current_year <= { value = kehillah_lib_year_work_tosafot add = kehillah_review_haskamah_years } global_var:kehillah_review_unread_this_year < kehillah_review_unread_cap }
		kehillah_review_unread_effect = { KEY = work_tosafot }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_zohar_written current_year <= { value = kehillah_lib_year_work_zohar add = kehillah_review_haskamah_years } global_var:kehillah_review_unread_this_year < kehillah_review_unread_cap }
		kehillah_review_unread_effect = { KEY = work_zohar }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_01_written current_year <= { value = kehillah_lib_year_work_authored_01 add = kehillah_review_haskamah_years } global_var:kehillah_review_unread_this_year < kehillah_review_unread_cap }
		kehillah_review_unread_effect = { KEY = work_authored_01 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_02_written current_year <= { value = kehillah_lib_year_work_authored_02 add = kehillah_review_haskamah_years } global_var:kehillah_review_unread_this_year < kehillah_review_unread_cap }
		kehillah_review_unread_effect = { KEY = work_authored_02 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_03_written current_year <= { value = kehillah_lib_year_work_authored_03 add = kehillah_review_haskamah_years } global_var:kehillah_review_unread_this_year < kehillah_review_unread_cap }
		kehillah_review_unread_effect = { KEY = work_authored_03 }
